ar.title: الكوسة

steps.n1: يضرب البصل والفلفل الأخضر والطماطم والخل والثوم في الخلاط.
steps.n2: يشوَح الخضار المضروب في الزيت حتى يغلي على حرارة هادئة.
steps.n3: تشوَح الكوسة جيدا في هذا الخليط ونسكب عليها المرق حتى الغليان.

en.title: Zucchini

steps.n1: Blend the onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, vinegar, and garlic in a blender.
steps.n2: Sauté the blended mixture in oil until it reaches a boil over low heat.
steps.n3: Sauté the zucchini thoroughly in this mixture and pour in the broth until it boils.
steps.n4: Reduce the heat and simmer until cooked through.

legacySteps: Blend the onion, bell pepper, tomatoes, vinegar, and garlic in a blender.
Sauté the blended mixture in oil until it reaches a boil over low heat.
Sauté the zucchini thoroughly in this mixture and pour in the broth until it boils.
Reduce the heat and simmer until cooked through.
